name: Methylenedioxyphenmetrazine
summary: 3,4-Methylenedioxyphenmetrazine (MDPM or 3-MDPM) is a recreational designer drug with stimulant effects. It is a substituted phenylmorpholine derivative, closely related to better known drugs such as phenmetrazine and 3-fluorophenmetrazine. It has been identified as a synthetic impurity formed in certain routes of MDMA manufacture.

uses.text: 3,4-Methylenedioxyphenmetrazine (MDPM or 3-MDPM) is a recreational designer drug with stimulant effects.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related phenmetrazine stimulants can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, sleeplessness, anxiety and compulsive redosing.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。相關的芬美曲秦類興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、血壓上升、失眠、焦慮與強迫性追加使用。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。相关的芬美曲秦类兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、血压上升、失眠、焦虑与强迫性追加使用。

fact.en: MDPM belongs to the family of phenmetrazine, the 1950s diet pill Preludin, but carries the methylenedioxy ring of MDMA on its benzene ring.
fact.zh: MDPM 屬於芬美曲秦家族，也就是1950年代的減肥藥 Preludin，但它的苯環上帶有 MDMA 的亞甲二氧基環。
fact.zhHans: MDPM 属于芬美曲秦家族，也就是1950年代的减肥药 Preludin，但它的苯环上带有 MDMA 的亚甲二氧基环。
